payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results related to the models used, particularly improvements in recall and precision scores, as well as the overall performance of deep neural network models after data augmentation.

claims.text: Oversampled datasets (F+, T+, W+) showed significantly better performance compared to their counterparts (F, T, W).
Recall score improved dramatically with TL2 compared to TL1, indicating better performance in detecting cyberbullying.
There was a significant improvement in precision as well, highlighting enhanced model performance.
Overall performance of all DNN models improved significantly with data augmentation, showing major leaps in evaluation measures.
